applies_to: all models and all BigEarthNet external fixture rows

sentinel_2_optical.transform: clip band to [0,3000], divide by 3000, multiply by 255, round, cast uint8
sentinel_2_optical.normalization: none after uint8 rendering; model processor may apply its fixed preprocessing

sentinel_1_sar.domain: dB, as indicated by negative VV/VH training means in BigEarthNet.txt datamodule

channel_mapping.R: VV clipped to [-25,0] then scaled to [0,255]
channel_mapping.G: VH clipped to [-32,-5] then scaled to [0,255]

sentinel_1_sar.normalization: none after uint8 rendering; model processor may apply its fixed preprocessing
